title: Sunnydaze Décor Northern Lights Gazing Globe
amazon_match_notes: Exact match on Sunnydaze ZIB-543 (UPC 810011713543, ASIN B085LW4H36): 10-inch Northern Lights single globe.

comparisons.notes: Live Shopify variant data: 'Northern Lights / 1', SKU ZIB-543, $64.95, available=true. The 2-pack ZIB-543-2PK is $89.95 and is a different pack quantity.

writeup: Woot has the Sunnydaze Northern Lights 10-inch handblown glass gazing globe (model ZIB-543, UPC 810011713543) for $28.99. It is a single globe with blue-green aurora swirls and a rubber-capped stem that fits most stands. Sunnydaze Decor's own site lists the matching Northern Lights / 1 variant, SKU ZIB-543, at $64.95 and shows it in stock. That is 55 percent below the verified store price and saves about $36. Woot showed 3+ left with a limit of three per customer.
